expectedAnswers.q11: Runway is not determinable because the fixture has no positively classified operating burn. The available numerators are $7,041,552.68 of gross stablecoin assets and $36,659,437.35 of NAV, but dividing either by a missing/zero classified burn would create a false runway figure.
